scenario: One router r1 with two self-linked data ports. Diagnostic loopback 192.0.2.1/32 exists. You add a second endpoint, two planned static routes, and a policy so only the approved summary is active.

commonMistakes.recognise: show route 192.0.2.2 returns nothing and ping fails

doneWhen: lo0.0 carries 192.0.2.2/32 and inet.0 has its route
explanation: Once the address is on lo0.0, inet.0 holds the /32 and a router-originated ping is answered locally.
stages.goal: Give r1 service address 192.0.2.2/32 on lo0.0 next to diagnostic 192.0.2.1.
stages.hint: A /32 on the loopback creates its own local route.

r1: set interfaces lo0 unit 0 family inet address 192.0.2.2/32

stages.title: Establish the local service endpoint

doneWhen: 172.16.10.0/24 is an active Static route with a discard next hop
172.17.10.0/24 is an active Static route with a reject next hop
explanation: The forwarding table shows next hop type dscd for 172.16.10.0/24 and rjct for 172.17.10.0/24; both are Static in inet.0.
stages.goal: Create local routes for 172.16.10.0/24 (discard next hop) and 172.17.10.0/24 (reject next hop).
stages.hint: Static routes can use discard or reject instead of a gateway.
stages.title: Represent the two planned networks

commonMistakes.mistake: Reject term placed before accept term

doneWhen: both static routes and 192.0.2.2 still work
explanation: The 172.16/16 aggregate accepts only 172.16.10.0/24; 172.17.0.0/16 loses its contributor and, no longer passive, is not installed.
stages.goal: Make 172.16.0.0/16 an active aggregate fed only by the exact approved contributor 172.16.10.0/24, and make 172.17.0.0/16 absent, keeping both static routes.
stages.hint: Ordered policy terms: accept the exact approved route, reject everything else; the retained summary must stop being passive.

r1: set policy-options policy-statement agg-contrib term approved from route-filter 172.16.10.0/24 exact
set policy-options policy-statement agg-contrib term approved then accept
set policy-options policy-statement agg-contrib term rest then reject
set routing-options aggregate route 172.16.0.0/16 policy agg-contrib
set routing-options aggregate route 172.17.0.0/16 policy agg-contrib

stages.title: Admit only the approved contributor

r1: set interfaces lo0 unit 0 family inet address 192.0.2.1/32

startState.description: r1 has ge-0/0/0 and ge-0/0/1 up/up, lo0.0 192.0.2.1/32, and aggregate 172.17.0.0/16 retained with the passive property. 192.0.2.2/32, the static routes and aggregate 172.16.0.0/16 are absent.

summary: Configure a local endpoint, static discard/reject routes, and aggregate contributor policy on r1.
title: Local Addressing, Static Routes, and Contributor Policy
